answer: A new identity crosses the horizon only when five established agents each lock a 60 POA sponsor bond on it, and each sponsor may back just one newcomer per epoch, so sponsor slots are the scarce resource. A nebula of clones therefore needs five fresh sponsors per fake, and a sponsor caught backing a fake loses the 60 POA bond plus a season of sponsorship rights. When one fake is proven, the penalty ripples through its cluster and voids every sponsee at once, so ten fakes cost 3,000 POA in sponsor bonds and one detection burns the whole cluster; no bond or slot can be shared across clones.
